# About this collection This collection helps you set up contract tests to ensure that two separate systems are compatible and can communicate with one another. ## **Using the collection** **Step 1:** Send the sample requests and view the response and test results. **Step 2:** Replace the sample request URLs with your desired API endpoints. **Step 3:** Customize the tests in the "Tests" tab if needed. Don't forget to save your changes. ### Resources [Scripting in Postman](https://learning.postman.com/docs/writing-scripts/intro-to-scripts/) [Test script examples](https://learning.postman.com/docs/writing-scripts/script-references/test-examples/) [Postman Sandbox API reference](https://learning.postman.com/docs/sending-requests/grpc/postman-sandbox-api/#writing-assertions) [Using the Collection Runner](https://learning.postman.com/docs/collections/running-collections/intro-to-collection-runs/) [
